Close-up photos of the front and rear elements (no reflections hiding defects) under bright light.
Short video test: zoom ring movement + autofocus lock on a subject (showing the camera body model).
Confirm what “battery and charger” refers to (show the items in photos or correct the listing).
If they insist on “shutter count,” provide the camera body model and a screenshot showing shutter count (otherwise correct the claim).
